<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-1611-42-21" status="unreviewed">
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs></note> 'di skad gsung sems can  tsam po la nog lkog shal rten tsam du yod pas ba lang gi tha snyad kyis khyab par mtshon  na
              mtshon bya la ltos te khyab ches pa'i skyon yin gyi mtshan gzhi la ltos te skyon Na yin | seMn tsam po las ldog ha pa laso pa 'dus pa khyab byed du yod pas ba lang gi
               <lb n="15a8"/>tha snyad kyis khyab par mtshon na <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> kyi ngo bo mi srid pa yin gyi der ma 'dus pa'i phyogs 1 la ma khyab nas mi srid pa ni ma yin te | nog lkogs pa seMn la khyab byed du yod pa rang shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir zhes zer ba 'di yang mi 'thad de | nog skog khal seMn la khyab byed du yod pa ces pa de 'god tshul yin de ltar mi srid pa de nog
               <lb n="15a9"/>lkog shal gyi ngo bo seMn la gtan tha pas lan ni yod kyang phyogs 1 la ma khyab pas lan | dang po ltar na kar zhag skyur gyi seMn la Na par 'gyur</seg></TEI>
